name: RainWright
description: RainWright is an independent UI tool for Rain World region creators, designed to provide a more modern, intuitive and efficient development experience.<LINE><LINE>RainWright redesigns the page layout and interactions of the vanilla Dev Tools and integrates the features of World Editor and Cornifer into one visual workspace.<LINE><LINE>Built around familiar workflows and developer needs, RainWright adds two-way room connections, hot reloading for connection changes and creature spawns, custom sound grouping and management, more human-friendly shortcuts, and automatic save recovery to simplify content creation and debugging.
requirements_names: Rain World ImGUI API (1.12.0 or later)
